[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842331/15a74164fca82f4e1cf255b3d2d7075d48799fa7.jpg[/img]

The new version adds support for the English version of the system, and both the game interface and subtitles support the English version. At the same time, based on feedback from the previous version, a subtitle function switch has been added, which can be switched in the settings function of the main interface. I wish you all a happy game!

notes.title: Simplified Chinese subtitles now supported
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44842331/249c1ae1806bb2e1026d43eccba461575407d0ec.jpg[/img]


After the initial launch period, the studio’s partners added Chinese subtitles to the new version based on player feedback. English subtitles will also be supported soon. We sincerely thank all players for their experience and feedback. Every feedback is valuable experience for us.
